counts.description: Rows landing in each split for this stratum.
counts.title: Counts

total.description: Total rows read from the source dataset.
total.title: Total

ratios_achieved.description: counts[name] / total for each split, rounded.
ratios_achieved.title: Ratios Achieved

ratios_requested.description: The requested train/val/[test] ratios, normalized to sum to 1.
ratios_requested.title: Ratios Requested

no_leakage.description: True iff zero group (per group_by) spans more than one split — the leakage-check evidence the readiness report cites.
no_leakage.title: No Leakage

group_by.description: The group field used, if any.
group_by.title: Group By

group_count.description: Distinct group keys seen, when group_by is set.
group_count.title: Group Count

stratify_by.description: The stratify field used, if any.
stratify_by.title: Stratify By

stratification_summary.description: Per-stratum split counts, when stratify_by is set.
stratification_summary.title: Stratification Summary

output_paths.description: Split name -> its PRIMARY JSONL file path (the first/only shard). Unchanged when unsharded; the first shard when shard_size > 0.
output_paths.title: Output Paths

shard_paths.description: Split name -> every shard file written for it (#891). A single-element list per split when unsharded; the full ordered shard list when shard_size > 0 (read all of them for the complete split).
shard_paths.title: Shard Paths

child_versions.description: #2020 — split name -> the frozen child version it registered, as 'dataset:<name>@<version>'. Empty when register_as was not set.
child_versions.title: Child Versions

child_hashes.description: #2020 — split name -> the child version's content hash. Same input + same policy reproduces the same hash (and therefore the same version); a different policy mints a new one.
child_hashes.title: Child Hashes

split_policy.description: #2020 — the DECLARED policy recorded on every child version: ratios, stratify_by, group_by, seed, backend. A split whose policy is not on the record is a random tail nobody can reproduce.
split_policy.title: Split Policy
